snippet.title: Tame Me Hard! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/tame-me-hard/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4071430/Tame_Me_Hard/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

Take on the role of a female adventurer with debts to pay in this side-scrolling dungeon crawler. Head into different types of dungeons to encounter various creatures. Fight them, capture and train them, then sell them for profit. Pay off your debt before time runs out!
